# CLEAR MODEL PROGRAMS

Drop the model program and the derivatives program of the last MODEL PROGRAM.

## Syntax

```text
CLEAR MODEL PROGRAMS.
```

The model program and the derivatives program are dropped, so a new MODEL PROGRAM can start afresh. NLR uses its programs up when it runs.

## Example

```text
CLEAR MODEL PROGRAMS.
```

`statscraft help CLEAR MODEL PROGRAMS` prints the same text in the terminal. [All commands](README.md)
